title: Regressor-Guided Image Editing Shifts Emotion and Disengagement Timing in Social Media
abstract: arXiv:2501.12289v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Internet overuse is a widespread phenomenon in today's digital society. Existing interventions, such as time limits or grayscaling, often rely on restrictive controls that provoke psychological reactance and are frequently circumvented. Building on prior work showing that emotional responses mediate the relationship between content consumption and online engagement, we investigate whether regulating the emotional impact of images can reduce online use in a non-coercive manner.   We introduce and systematically analyze three regressor-guided image-editing approaches, spanning low-level attribute optimization, latent style-space optimization, and diffusion-based editing. While the first two modify low-level visual features (e.g., contrast, color), the diffusion-based method enables higher-level changes (e.g., adjusting clothing, facial features). translated_title: 回归器引导的图像编辑改变社交媒体中的情绪与脱离参与时间
translated_abstract: 互联网过度使用是当今数字社会中的普遍现象。现有的干预措施，如时间限制或灰度化，往往依赖于引发心理抗拒的限制性控制，且常被规避。基于先前研究表明情绪反应调节内容消费与在线参与之间关系的发现，我们探讨是否可以通过调节图像的情绪影响来以非强制方式减少在线使用。我们引入并系统分析了三种回归器引导的图像编辑方法，涵盖低级属性优化、潜在风格空间优化以及基于扩散的编辑。前两种方法修改低级视觉特征（如对比度、颜色），而基于扩散的方法能够实现更高级别的变化（如调整衣物、面部特征）。一项受控图像评分研究显示，只有基于扩散的方法能够改变情绪，并影响脱离参与的时间。
tldr: 本研究提出并比较了三种回归器引导的图像编辑方法，发现仅基于扩散的编辑能够非强制性地调节图像情绪，从而减少社交媒体中的在线使用。
en_tdlr: This study introduces and compares three regressor-guided image-editing methods, finding that only diffusion-based editing can non-coercively modulate image emotion and reduce online engagement.
